metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (tropospheric nitrogen dioxide) - Dates: * Reference period: January 1-20, 2020 * Comparison period: February 10-25, 2020 - Locations: Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan (three separate cities in China) - Band: NO2 (tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density) 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P has quality flags. Filter by QA value ≥ 0.75 (good quality) - No cloud masking needed for TROPOMI (it's at 7km resolution and pre-processed) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error (C3): - Check if NO2 values are within valid range (0-5 μmol/m² is typical) - Check if both periods have valid data (non-null means) - Compare: if all three cities show decrease, answer A; if any city shows increase, answer B - If data missing for any period/city, attempt recovery or output C1 - If after filtering valid pixels = 0, output C2 - If mean values are None/NaN or out of valid range, output C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define three cities (point locations) const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]); const chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.5516, 29.5630]); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]); const cities = { beijing, chongqing, wuhan }; // Define periods const jan_start = '2020-01-01'; const jan_end = '2020-01-20'; const feb_start = '2020-02-10'; const feb_end = '2020-02-25'; // Load Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 collection const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Function to get mean NO2 for a period and location async function getMeanNO2(geom, startDate, endDate, label) { const col = collection .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geom); const size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`${label}: 0 images found`); return null; } // Get mean value const meanImg = col.mean(); const result = await meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanVal = result.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; console.log(`${label}: ${size} images, Mean NO2: ${meanVal !== null ? meanVal.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); return meanVal; } // Analysis const results = {}; let allDataValid = true; for (const [cityName, geom] of Object.entries(cities)) { console.log(`\n--- ${cityName.toUpperCase()} ---`); const jan_mean = await getMeanNO2(geom, jan_start, jan_end, `${cityName} Jan 1-20`); const feb_mean = await getMeanNO2(geom, feb_start, feb_end, `${cityName} Feb 10-25`); if (jan_mean === null || feb_mean === null) { console.log(`${cityName}: Missing data for one or both periods`); allDataValid = false; results[cityName] = null; continue; } // Validate range (NO2 typically 0-5 μmol/m²) if (jan_mean < 0 || jan_mean > 10 || feb_mean < 0 || feb_mean > 10) { console.log(`${cityName}: Value out of valid range`); results[cityName] = null; allDataValid = false; continue; } const decreased = feb_mean < jan_mean; results[cityName] = { jan: jan_mean, feb: feb_mean, decreased }; console.log(`${cityName}: Jan=${jan_mean.toFixed(6)}, Feb=${feb_mean.toFixed(6)}, Decreased=${decreased}`); } // Determine final answer console.log('\n--- FINAL RESULT ---'); if (!allDataValid) { console.log('C1'); return; } const validCities = Object.values(results).filter(r => r !== null); if (validCities.length === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } if (validCities.length < 3) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Check if ALL three cities decreased const allDecreased = validCities.every(r => r.decreased); console.log(`All three cities decreased: ${allDecreased}`); if (allDecreased) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
